verdicts.evidence: lines 578, 589, 599, 453: Find rooms calls search(), Book room calls book(), Book another room pushes state and routes to the form, Try again re-runs search. Every button has a working handler.
lines 390, 401, 462-483, 525, 546-564: rooms and the booking shown come from api.findRooms and api.createBooking; no hardcoded records, sample text or placeholders. Empty result says so (446-448).
lines 136-169 criteria form stays visible above the rooms; lines 196, 494-499 summary of room, date, time range and people sits above Book room; done view lists every detail (557-563).

lines 317-344, 579-598, 608-613: every input saves a sessionStorage draft, reload restores values and re-runs the search; failed search or booking leaves fields untouched (397-399, 534-536); done view lives in history.state (539).

lines 154, 165, 186, 414-419: defaults are 1 hour, 2 people, catering unticked, smallest fitting room preselected and named in the summary. Enter triggers Find rooms or Book room, neither loses data or adds cost.
lines 133-201: criteria, room choice, details and Book room are all on one screen with no dialog; only the booked confirmation is a separate view (203-209).

lines 136-209: when/length/people, free rooms, title, catering, note, book, booked confirmation all map to the brief. No stat cards, tips or extra sections; Book another room only returns to the flow.
line 427: Find rooms drops btn-primary when status is ready, so Book room (198) is the only primary then; in failed state Try again is plain .btn (452); done view has one button (207).
No action deletes, overwrites or is destructive; buttons are Find rooms, Try again, Book room, Book another room (168, 198, 207, 452).

lines 429, 518: aria-disabled only while the button's own request runs (exception). When criteria change, the booking form is hidden (426) and line 456 says why in text. No unexplained disabled control.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (134-207, 368-375, 443-456, 489-491, 535, 548-563) concern the booking task; none mentions implementation, mock data or the request.

line 456 stale note sits where results were and tells the user to search again; lines 489-491 catering message sits under the catering box; line 535 by the Book button. Each ties to a specific action.
No intro or narration under the h1 (134-136). Remaining guidance is single state lines at the place concerned: 448 'Try another time or a shorter meeting', 456 'Find rooms again to see what is free'.
No subtitles or helper text on fields (138-194). Empty state heading 'No rooms free' (447) is followed by a line adding the searched criteria and next step (448), not a bare restatement.
Headings 'Book a meeting room', 'Free rooms', 'Meeting details', '<room> is booked' (134, 172, 178, 548); no greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or congratulations.
Button labels: 'Find rooms' (168), 'Book room' (198), 'Book another room' (207), 'Try again' (452), busy labels 'Finding rooms...' and 'Booking...' (428, 517). All start with a specific verb.

line 563 shows the raw server id (e.g. bk_48211) as 'Booking reference'. Feature enums are mapped to words (263, 477) and error codes never shown. Whether a labelled reference counts as a system ID is a judgement that went both ways.

lines 368-375, 395, 450-452, 489-491, 533, 535: each message names the problem and next step ('Could not load the rooms because the connection failed' plus Try again); e.message and codes are never rendered (390, 525).
lines 450 and 535 use the word 'failed' ('because the connection failed'), which the rule's test lists as not allowed. Otherwise neutral: no exclamation marks, capitals or blame.
lines 446-448: zero rooms shows heading 'No rooms free' and 'Nothing is free for N people on <when>. Try another time or a shorter meeting.' with the criteria form and Find rooms directly above.
lines 442-457: loading, empty (446-448, change criteria), failed (449-454, notice plus Try again) and stale (455-456, search again) each render a different message and next step.
lines 397-399, 449-454: failed load shows a notice and Try again in the results area; lines 534-536: failed booking shows a notice above Book room, fields untouched and button re-enabled (526-528).

lines 385-387, 428, 443: on search the button reads 'Finding rooms...' and the section shows 'Finding rooms...' at once; line 517: 'Booking...' on submit. Calls last at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel needed.

lines 385-386, 441-445: status is 'loading' until the response; heading stays 'Free rooms', body shows 'Finding rooms...', booking form hidden (426). 'No rooms free' only set after the response (402).

lines 32, 113, 118, 122: overflow-wrap anywhere on heading, room text, summary and dd; min-width 0 on flex/grid children; room list is a growing grid (97); empty note shows 'None' (562); empty features handled (477-478).
lines 317-325, 587, 592, 597: edits are written to sessionStorage on every input/change and restored on return or reload (327-344, 608), so navigating away and back keeps them.

No rule text under Date, Start time or Number of people (138-167); constraints (not in past, whole number 1+) appear only as errors (369-375). Native date/time/number inputs with min (165, 606) arguably convey them. Verdict differed on second pass.

line 192: note labelled '(optional)' and has no required attribute; date, start, people, title carry required (140, 145, 165, 181); catering is a tick box, optional by nature; length select always has a value.

lines 363-377, 508-513: validation runs only on submit; input handlers only clear errors (580, 591). The catering mismatch message appears on change of the tick box or room, not while typing (594-597).

lines 141, 146, 166, 182, 189: each field has its own error paragraph directly beneath it; marked by 'Error: ' text prefix (70) and 2px border (67) as well as colour. Connection error is form-level (197).
lines 381-382, 392-399, 513, 530-536: client and server rejections only set messages; no field is cleared. resetForm runs only after a successful booking (540).
lines 382, 396, 513, 531, 533: focus moves to the first invalid field; setError sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the message (351). Connection errors use role=alert (197, 450).

lines 168, 198: submit buttons never get the disabled attribute; pressing with missing input shows field messages and focuses the first (363-382, 508-513). aria-disabled only while in flight (429, 518).

line 380: search returns if status is loading; line 504: book returns if state.booking is true; buttons show 'Finding rooms...' / 'Booking...' with aria-disabled until the response (428-429, 517-518, 526-528).

lines 385-387: search renders the loading state synchronously (button label and section text); lines 515-518: Book label changes before the await; room radio updates summary on change (594-596); Book another routes at once (599-602).

Success: room list with count heading (445), booked view '<room> is booked' with details (548-563). Failure: notices at 450, 535 and field errors at 395, 531, 533. Every branch of both calls states its outcome.
The only success message is the booked view (546-564), which is the sole place the result is visible; no toast or banner duplicates a result already on screen.

No timers dismiss anything (no setTimeout outside the server block). Load failure stays in place with Try again (449-454); booking notice stays until the next attempt (516, 535-536); field errors clear on correction (580, 591).
No action removes, archives, moves or changes an existing item; the only server write is creating a booking (525).
No action permanently deletes, overwrites, sends something unrecallable or spends money; creating a booking (503-543) is preceded by a summary line (196) but is not of that class.
No confirmation dialogs: no dialog element, confirm() or modal markup anywhere in the file.
No optimistic updates: the booked view is shown only after createBooking resolves (525, 537-542), and rooms only after findRooms resolves (390-406).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
lines 134-200: the page opens on the criteria form, followed by free rooms and meeting details; nothing decorative precedes or outweighs them.
lines 133-136: h1 'Book a meeting room' is followed directly by the form; no hero, greeting or intro panel.
line 445: the only summary number is the heading 'N rooms free', which tells the user how many choices they have; no stat cards or charts.
The room list is the result of required search criteria that stay visible in the form above (136-169) with a count heading (445); there are no optional filters, sorting or hidden columns to clear.

All controls are native: date, time, select, number, text, textarea, checkbox, radios, buttons (138-198, 466-470). aria-disabled keeps buttons focusable (429, 518). No click-only custom widgets, no focus traps.
line 70: errors carry an 'Error: ' text prefix besides red; line 67 thicker border; selected room is a checked native radio plus border (111-112); notices are text (450, 535).

The stale message (456) is added with no role and no say(); the catering mismatch shown when a room radio changes (496, 596) has no live region; the load-failure alert is created with its text and then inserted (450), not a pre-existing region. #live (211) covers only loading and results.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, custom comboboxes or tabs; the only dropdown is a native select (150).

line 5 viewport meta; line 45 auto-fit minmax(150px) collapses the when-grid to one column at 375px; lines 123-127 full-width buttons and stacked dl; inputs width 100% and 44px min height (55-56); long names wrap (113).
